purpose.evidence: README introduces the experimental pre-Start predictor in RU/EN and directs players to the released alpha.1 package and guide; AGENTS supplies working rules, while CONTRIBUTING points to the contribution standard.

structure.evidence: The two changed README paragraphs sit under Documentation, after the purpose and canonical links. The short repository entry point does not duplicate the player manual. AGENTS and CONTRIBUTING are unchanged.

specificity.evidence: Both README languages name the alpha.1 release, ordinary game launch without the SDK, pre-Start forecast, native after-Start Placement control, canonical guide and published-archive boundary. The C++ delta excludes ranged units from melee subsets and handles an empty melee subset with a known hero; it adds no new player instruction.

reproducibility.evidence: README retains the canonical installation and standalone-clone links, pinned xkit/Game API revisions and git submodule update --init. The release link resolves to v0.2.0-alpha.1; the guide source gives package download and player workflow. This review did not repeat installation.

evidence.evidence: GitHub release v0.2.0-alpha.1 identifies source 0e1fadb and archive SHA-256 40ad7daae635ec92ea548aab406f30ca124e9cad3303dd7d412dea2f48c2ce84. player20-public-alpha-release-recovered.json records the public download hash; predictor-alpha-knowledge-deployed-verification.json records published website e2c1a81. The changed native code has a scoped development HMR proof, ordinary-large-melee-archer100-live-after-start-coherent.json (7/7 positions), not a new released-package or global-accuracy result.

applicability.evidence: README explicitly says working-branch changes do not alter the published archive, and now delegates release results and limitations to the alpha.1 player guide. It removes the earlier candidate's moving 273/273 and 175/213 wording. The native patch is not published, and no new performance or whole-campaign claim appears.

translations.evidence: The revised RU and EN paragraphs agree on alpha.1, SDK-free ordinary launch, pre-/post-Start behavior, guide ownership, unchanged published archive and architecture contract. The retained purpose and setup sections also remain paired.

maintenance.evidence: The website remains the sole living player guide; the README links it in both languages. Root research diary already records the 2026-10-03 empty melee subset and hero contribution with a bounded 24/24 calculation and one 7/7 battle; this review adds no duplicate article or broad claim. No canonical article changed in the three-path source delta, so new article critics do not apply.
